dict.string: Meeting Note Taker records your microphone locally to transcribe meetings on-device. Audio never leaves your Mac.
Adversaria records the audio of your meetings (the sound this Mac plays) to transcribe them on this device. Nothing leaves your Mac.
Adversaria reads your calendar events to suggest meeting attendees. This stays on your Mac.
